Definition: to glow or grow warm; figuratively (usually) to blaze up, of anger, zeal, jealousy
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be hot, furious, burn, becomeangry, be kindled; 1a) (Qal) to burn, kindle (anger); 1b) (Niphal) to be angry with, be incensed; 1c) (Hiphil) to burn, kindle; 1d) (Hithpael) to heat oneself in vexation
